title: Frozen contract: pure magnet descriptor (v1)
description: Frozen at L0 per SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §6 Lot 0. Source: spec/SPEC_RE_JOINTJS_PARITY.md §4.7 (lines 209-220). Pure replacement for the upstream (view, magnet: SVGElement) triple: anchors and connection points are pure functions of this descriptor plus the reference point; connectionPoints.boundary intersects the end segment with shape (options insideout, extrapolate, sticky, stroke, offset) instead of descending a DOM subtree (line 219). pinRelative computes dx/dy percentages rounded to 3 decimals against bbox after rotating the drop point by -angle (line 219-220). strokeWidth is the resolved presentation value, never read from a DOM node.

shape.description: World geometry of the magnet part: Rect | Ellipse | PathOutline | PolygonOutline (spec line 214).

localMatrix.description: Part-local to world affine, rotation included (spec line 215).

portId.description: Stable part/port identity when the magnet is a port (spec line 217).

bbox.description: Unrotated bounding box used by pinRelative-style rules (spec line 218).
